title: Membrane Crystallization: streaming PCA with a Hebbian running average (SYNTHETIC)
description:
SYNTHETIC. Standard-library Python package for streaming PCA: the Hebbian update W <- (1 - alpha) W + alpha |x><x| is an exponentially weighted running estimate of the observation covariance, and its top-K eigenvectors are its principal components (as in Oja 1982). 'Crystallization' is a descriptive label only. Includes a Jacobi eigensolver for complex Hermitian matrices that handles repeated eigenvalues, and seeded sweeps measuring the learning curve, the forgetting window (about 1/alpha), residue-whiteness controls (which show the metric does not separate patterns from pure noise) and self-recreation chains, whose fidelity decays over 20 generations.
